fields.summary_ko.0: META trades at an annual P/E of 18.78x, undervalued versus the industry average of 26.90x, but Q3 expenses surged 68% year-over-year, resulting in a 37% decline in operating profit
fields.summary_ko.1: META's 2026 capital expenditure target of $135–145 billion and non-cancellable contract commitments of $454.5 billion are creating cash outflow pressure that constrains stock price appreciation
